meta.name: 📖 How To Use Tailliuir Studio ⭐
meta.description:
🧵 Welcome to Tailliuir Studio 🧵

Everything is already set up and ready to use. This guide explains the basics so you can get the best experience.

👍 Choosing a Stream
👍👍 2 Thumbs: Best quality (above 1080p, including 1440p and 4K). Best for 4K TVs and devices.
👍 1 Thumb: 720p to 1080p. Recommended for most TVs, phones and tablets.
👎 Thumb Down: Below 720p. Only use if nothing else is available.

💡 Not sure what to pick?
Most people should choose 👍.
If you have a 4K TV, you can choose 👍👍 for the best quality.

▶️ Watching Something
Choose a film or TV show, then pick the 👍 or 👍👍 option that matches your device.

⚠️ Something Not Working?
Use the QR codes inside Tailliuir Studio:

📱 App Not Working?
Check if the app is having problems.

🎬 No Thumbs Showing?
Check if there is a problem finding watch options.

▶️ Thumbs Won't Play?
Check if there is a problem playing videos.

🔄 Backup Options
If the main watch options stop working, you may see Backup 1, Backup 2, Backup 3 and so on.

These are alternative options and should only be used if the main system is unavailable.
Backup options do not use the 👍 rating system, so choose the highest quality that your device can handle.

🎁 Support the Project
Tailliuir Studio is maintained privately. If you would like to help support the project, a donation QR code is available.

🆘 Need a Hand?
If you are still having trouble, scan the support QR code and get in touch.

Enjoy watching! 🍿
